# blockymodel-web

> Web-based 3D editor for BlockyModel format (.blockymodel) built with Three.js. Provides selection, transform gizmos, property editing, hierarchy management, UV editing, and undo/redo support.

## Overview

BlockyModel is a JSON-based 3D model format used for voxel-style game assets. This library provides both a viewer and full editor for creating and modifying .blockymodel files in the browser.

## Installation

```bash
npm install blockymodel-web three
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { Editor, ViewerController, BlockyModelLoader } from 'blockymodel-web';

// Create viewer
const viewer = new ViewerController(container);

// Load model
const loader = new BlockyModelLoader();
const model = await loader.loadAsync('model.blockymodel');
viewer.scene.add(model);

// Enable editing
const editor = new Editor(viewer.scene, viewer.camera, viewer.renderer, viewer.controls);
```

## Core Components

- **Editor**: Central state manager coordinating selection, transforms, and history
- **SelectionManager**: Raycasting-based 3D object selection with visual highlighting
- **TransformManager**: Three.js TransformControls wrapper (G=translate, R=rotate, S=scale)
- **History**: Undo/redo stack using command pattern with automatic merging
- **Serializer**: Exports Three.js scene graph back to BlockyModel JSON format

## UI Components

- **PropertyPanel**: Edit position, rotation, scale, and shape properties
- **HierarchyPanel**: Tree view with context menu for add/delete/duplicate nodes
- **UVEditor**: Per-face texture UV offset, mirror, and rotation controls

## Commands (for undo/redo)

- SetPositionCommand, SetRotationCommand, SetScaleCommand
- SetPropertyCommand (supports nested property paths)
- AddNodeCommand, RemoveNodeCommand

## BlockyModel Format

```typescript
interface BlockyModel {
  format?: "character" | "prop";
  lod?: "auto" | string;
  nodes: BlockyNode[];
}

interface BlockyNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  position?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  orientation?: { w: number; x: number; y: number; z: number };
  shape: BlockyShape;
  children: BlockyNode[];
}
```
